module_role: Reconciles every M3.01 schedule table identity to its printed source scope. Schedule rows, outlet types, coordination categories, refrigeration cross-references and M2.01 sample detail graphics are kept distinct rather than silently merged into physical equipment counts.

scheduled_families.class: Two-pipe chilled-water fan coil schedule mark

primary_anchors.visual_anchor: M3.01 Air Cooled Chiller Schedule row CH 2; left field / near gate 6.
M3.01 FCU row FCU 1, quantity 1, level 200 section 7.
M3.01 FCU row FCU 2, quantity 1, level 200 section 7.
M3.01 FCU row FCU 3, quantity 1, visitors clubhouse.
M3.01 FCU row FCU 4, quantity 1, ISFA conference room.
M3.01 FCU row FCU 5 prints quantity 11. The one schedule row and its printed quantity remain distinct from eleven individually located equipment identities.
M3.01 ACD row ACD 1: Visitors Clubhouse, 12x10, opposed blade, fail closed.
M3.01 ACD row ACD 2: ISFA Conference / Pressbox, verify existing size, opposed blade, fail closed.
M3.01 Condensing Units row CU 1; patio AHU / 200 level section 2.
M3.01 Condensing Units row CU 2; score board control / 200 level section 5.
M3.01 Condensing Units row CU 3; score board control / 200 level section 5.
M3.01 DX Coil row DC 1 cites CU-1 at patio; the row is kept as a scheduled coil identity and is not added to the CU quantity.

plan_and_detail_reconciliation.finding: Five FCU schedule marks print quantities 1, 1, 1, 1 and 11. The record retains five source rows plus their literal quantity cells; it does not manufacture eleven separately anchored FCU-5 tags.
ACD-1 and ACD-2 are populated automatic-control-damper rows. Their note assigns damper furnishing to MC and the listed-fail-position actuator to BASC.
The refrigeration schedule contains four reference rows. It is indexed independently from the equipment schedules and not used as a second equipment-instance count.
Full-page visual review identifies the valve tag/chart as a sample detail; it has no populated project valve rows and is not counted as a control-valve schedule.

control_valve_schedule.note: M2.01 has a valve-tag/valve-chart sample detail, but no populated project control-valve schedule row is supplied.

damper_actuator_schedule.note: ACD 1 and ACD 2 are populated schedule rows; both are opposed blade / fail closed. MC furnishes dampers and BASC furnishes actuators with the printed fail position.

source_conflicts.finding: The Air Cooled Chiller Schedule prints CH 2 at left field / near gate 6, while the Refrigeration Schedule prints CH 1 at left field with 475 tons. The source does not explicitly state that these are the same unit, so no alias is invented.

source_conflicts.scope: M3.01 FCU schedule vs M4.02 sequence
source_conflicts.finding: M3.01 locates FCU 1 at Level 200 Section 7, while M4.02 says FCU-1 is in the ISFA conference room for the OA-damper behavior. The conflicting printed location context is retained without correction.
